The M6, built on a 2-nanometer process, offers significant performance improvements over its predecessor, while the M5 Ultra utilizes UltraFusion technology to combine four dies into a single processor, delivering substantial gains in AI compute and graphics performance for professional workloads.

Title: Apple Reveals The Next-Gen M6 And M5 Ultra Chips - Here's What You Need To Know

Despite rumors of a short M6 generation, these chips represent a substantial leap from previous models, particularly in AI processing and graphical performance.
